chatutils.title: Chat Utils
chatutils.option.mention_enabled.desc: Watch incoming messages for your name and other keywords.
chatutils.option.mention_own_name.desc: Treat your account name as a keyword without adding it to the list.
chatutils.option.mention_whole_word.desc: "Mik" will not match "Mikhail" when this is on.
Require the exact capitalisation of the keyword.
chatutils.option.mention_ignore_self.des: Do not notify when you mention yourself.
chatutils.option.mention_regex.desc: Read every keyword as a regex pattern instead of as plain text. "Whole words only" is ignored in this mode — a pattern says for itself where it starts and ends.
chatutils.option.mention_keywords.desc: Extra words that trigger a mention: clan tags, nicknames, anything you want to be pinged for. An entry may carry its own colour and sound: "boss|#FF0000" or "boss|#FF0000|minecraft:entity.wither.spawn". Both parts are optional; a bad one falls back to the settings above rather than losing the alert.
chatutils.option.mention_exclusions.desc: If any of these matches the message, it never counts as a mention — no highlight, no sound. Useful for muting a bot that keeps saying your name.
chatutils.option.mention_highlight.desc: Recolour the matched keyword inside the message.
chatutils.option.mention_highlight_color: Colour applied to the matched keyword.
Also make the matched keyword bold.
chatutils.option.mention_sound.desc: Play a sound when you are mentioned.
chatutils.option.mention_sound_id.desc: A vanilla sound id such as minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup, or the file name of a .wav placed in:
chatutils.option.mention_sound_volume.de: How loud the mention sound is.
chatutils.option.mention_sound_pitch.des: Pitch of the mention sound. Has no effect on .wav files.
chatutils.option.mention_hotbar.desc: Print a line above the hotbar when you are mentioned.
chatutils.option.mention_hotbar_format.d: %s is replaced with the name of whoever mentioned you.
chatutils.option.mention_cooldown.desc: Minimum gap between two mention alerts, so spam cannot flood you.
chatutils.option.timestamp_mode.desc: Show the local time a message arrived, inline or as a tooltip.
chatutils.option.timestamp_format.desc: Java date pattern, for example HH:mm or HH:mm:ss.
chatutils.option.chat_heads.desc: Draw the sender's head beside their message.
chatutils.option.chat_heads_offset_all.d: Indent lines without a head as well, so all lines start at the same place.
chatutils.option.chat_animation.desc: Slide the chat up when a message arrives instead of snapping it into place.
chatutils.option.chat_animation_duration: How long the slide takes. Shorter feels snappier, longer feels smoother.
chatutils.option.linkify.desc: Turn bare URLs sent by servers into links you can click.
chatutils.option.compact_spam.desc: Merge identical consecutive messages into one line with an (x4) counter.
chatutils.option.compact_spam_window.des: How long a message waits so repeats can be merged into it. Higher catches more spam but delays chat.
chatutils.option.anti_clear.desc: Drop the wall of empty lines servers send to wipe your chat.
chatutils.option.anti_clear_threshold.de: How many blank lines in a row count as a clear attempt.
chatutils.option.symbol_bar.desc: Adds a button beside the chat input that opens a menu of special characters.
chatutils.option.override_window.desc: Apply the values below to the game's chat settings when you join a world.
chatutils.option.chat_height_focused.des: Height of the chat while it is open.
chatutils.option.chat_height_unfocused.d: How many lines stay visible while you are playing.
chatutils.option.chat_background_opacity: Opacity of the box behind the text.
chatutils.option.filter_enabled.desc: Censor or hide messages containing your blocked words.
chatutils.option.filter_mode.desc: Censor the word, or drop the whole message.
chatutils.option.filter_regex.desc: Read the list below as regular expressions instead of plain text.
chatutils.option.filter_censor_char.desc: Character the blocked word is replaced with.
chatutils.option.filtered_words.desc: Words to censor or hide. Matching ignores capitalisation.
chatutils.option.blacklist_enabled.desc: Hide every message written by the players listed below.
chatutils.option.friends_enabled.desc: Paint the names of your friends wherever they appear in chat.
chatutils.option.history_size.desc: How many messages the chat keeps. Vanilla stores 100.
chatutils.option.keep_history.desc: Do not wipe the chat when leaving a world. F3+D still clears it.
chatutils.option.session_divider.desc: Draw a line naming the world or server when you join one, so a kept backlog does not run two sessions together.
chatutils.option.chat_search_button.desc: Adds a magnifier above the chat input that opens the searchable history.
chatutils.option.hide_chat.desc: Stop drawing the chat while you play. Messages still arrive and stay in the history; hold the peek key or open the chat to see them.
chatutils.option.hide_chat_mentions.desc: Show the chat for a moment when someone mentions you.
chatutils.option.hide_chat_reveal.desc: How long the chat stays visible after a mention.
chatutils.option.message_sound.desc: Play a sound for every message, not just mentions.
chatutils.option.message_sound_id.desc: A vanilla sound id, or the file name of a .wav placed in:
chatutils.option.message_sound_volume.de: How loud the per-message sound is.
chatutils.option.message_sound_pitch.des: Pitch of the per-message sound. Has no effect on .wav files.
chatutils.option.message_sound_players_o: Only play for messages that came from a player.
chatutils.option.macros_enabled.desc: Expand [placeholders] in messages you send. Built-in placeholders:
chatutils.option.custom_macros.desc: One per entry, written as name=text. Typing [name] sends the text.
chatutils.option.calculator.desc: A message starting with the prefix is worked out and shown only to you, never sent. [=1+2] inside a message is replaced before sending.
chatutils.option.calculator_prefix.desc: What marks a message as a sum. Default is =
chatutils.option.no_reports.desc: Strip the signature from your chat so it cannot be attached to a Mojang report. Servers with enforce-secure-profile=true will reject unsigned chat.
chatutils.option.no_reports_warn.desc: Tell me when a server requires signed chat.
chatutils.noreports.secure_server: [Chat Utils] This server requires signed chat, so unsigned messages will be rejected. Turn "Send unsigned messages" off to chat here.
chatutils.noreports.secure_filter_off: [Chat Utils] Turned off the vanilla "Only Show Secure Chat" option: it hides every message whose sender cannot be verified, which now includes your own.
chatutils.noreports.not_working: [Chat Utils] Unsigned chat is enabled but no signature was stripped — the feature is not working on this game version. Your messages are still signed.
chatutils.history.title: Chat history
chatutils.history.save_hint: Writes every matching message to chat-logs/ in the game folder.
chatutils.option.chat_font_button.desc: Adds a button above the chat input for picking the alphabet outgoing messages are written in.
chatutils.option.chat_font.desc: Alphabet applied to messages you send. These are real Unicode characters, so everyone sees them without the mod — but they are not letters, so search and autocomplete on the server will not match them. Never applied to commands.
chatutils.option.stream_chat.desc: Show Twitch and YouTube live chat in the Minecraft chat. Read-only: nothing you type in Minecraft is ever sent to a stream.
chatutils.option.twitch_channel.desc: Channel name without the #, as it appears in the URL. Connects anonymously — no account, no token, nothing to paste.
chatutils.option.twitch_tag_color.desc: Colour of the Twitch tag, and of names from chatters who never picked a colour.
chatutils.option.youtube_video.desc: The v= part of a live stream's watch URL. The stream has to be live: an ended one has no chat left to read.
chatutils.option.youtube_key.desc: YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud. YouTube has no anonymous read access, so without a key this half stays off. Stored in chatutils.json in plain text — restrict the key to the YouTube Data API, and do not share the file.
chatutils.option.youtube_tag_color.desc: Colour of the YouTube tag and of chatter names.
chatutils.option.stream_rate.desc: How many stream messages may enter the chat each tick, per platform. The brake that keeps a busy channel from burying the game's own chat.
chatutils.option.stream_mentions.desc: Fire the usual mention alert when a stream message contains one of your keywords.
chatutils.option.link_domains.desc: Only links to these domains stay clickable, e.g. imgur.com. Subdomains are included, so i.imgur.com needs no entry of its own. Leave the list empty to allow every link. Blocked links are still shown and still readable — they just cannot be opened with one click.
chatutils.link.blocked: Domain is not on your clickable list
chatutils.option.hide_own_name.desc: Replace your account name with a row of characters wherever it appears in chat — for streaming and screenshots. Mentions still fire: the masking happens after the alert.
chatutils.option.hide_name_char.desc: The character your name is replaced with. The name keeps its length, so the rest of the line does not shift.
chatutils.option.hidden_names.desc: Anything else to keep out of the chat: an alt's name, a clan tag, a real name. Your own account name is always included.
chatutils.option.command_keys.desc: One per line as KEY | what to send, e.g. "G | /home" or "B | gg wp". An entry beginning with / is sent as a command, anything else as chat. Sent as though typed, so macros, the font and encryption still apply. These are read only while no screen is open, and they do not appear in the game's controls screen — so pick keys the game does not already use.
chatutils.option.chat_hud_offset.desc: Pixels to raise the chat while it is closed, to clear the armour bar. Applies only with the chat closed: a lifted chat would have links that do not click where they look, and with the chat closed there is nothing to click anyway.
chatutils.option.click_to_copy: Click a word to copy it
chatutils.option.click_to_copy.desc: Clicking any word in chat copies it to the clipboard. Links still open, and a censored word still offers to reveal itself.
chatutils.filter.reveal_hint: Click to see what this said
chatutils.filter.gone: That word is no longer remembered.
chatutils.option.filter_revealable.desc: Click a censored word to see what it said, shown only to you. You wrote the word list, so this keeps no secret from you — it makes a false positive diagnosable. Turn it off if someone else watches your screen.
chatutils.history.clear_hint: Empties the mod's message log. F3+D clears the chat but never reaches this.
chatutils.option.chat_delay.desc: How long a message waits before appearing. 0 is off.
chatutils.option.chat_links.desc: Let the game's own links be clicked.
chatutils.option.chat_links_prompt.desc: Show a confirmation before a chat link opens in your browser.
chatutils.option.replace_chat_settings.d: Send the "Chat Settings…" button in the game's options here instead. Every option that screen had lives in this config.
chatutils.option.symbol_suggestions.desc: Type a colon and a couple of letters — ":cro" offers a croissant, a crown, a crocodile. Click one to drop it in.
chatutils.option.symbols_everywhere.desc: Adds the picker to signs, books and the anvil too. The anvil has a real text box so the symbol goes straight in; signs and books draw their own text, so there it is copied for you to paste.
chatutils.option.translate_endpoint.desc:
Address of the server that does the translating. It must speak the LibreTranslate API, which is what most self-hosted and public translation servers offer.

Empty out of the box on purpose: a working public address baked in would point every copy of this mod at one stranger's server, and would quietly make "translate" mean "send this line to a third party". Your own server, or a service you chose.
chatutils.option.translate_key.desc: Whatever your endpoint wants, if it wants one. Stored in chatutils.json in plain text, like every other setting.
chatutils.option.translate_target.desc: Language to translate into. "My language" follows the game's own language setting.
chatutils.option.translate_source.desc: Language to translate from. "Detect" leaves it to the endpoint.
chatutils.translate.nothing: Nothing in the log to translate yet.
chatutils.translate.no_endpoint: No translation endpoint set — see Settings → Translation.
chatutils.option.chat_open_animation.des: Slide the chat into place when you open it, instead of it appearing at full height in one frame.
chatutils.option.translate_enabled.desc: Off until you have an endpoint to translate through. Nothing is ever translated on its own — only the message you ask for.
chatutils.translate.off: Translation is off — see Settings → Translation.
chatutils.option.chat_bubbles.desc: Show what a player said above their head for a few seconds. Off by default: this is the one feature that draws in the world rather than in the interface, which is the part of the game that changes most between versions.
chatutils.option.chat_bubble_ms.desc: How long a line stays above someone's head.
chatutils.option.chat_bubble_lines.desc: Older lines drop off the top.
chatutils.option.chat_bubble_length.desc: Longer messages are cut rather than wrapped — a wall of text over someone's head is not a bubble.
chatutils.option.chat_bubble_hide_self.d: You already know what you said, and in third person it sits in your face.
chatutils.option.encryption.desc: The server relays your messages but cannot read them, and neither can anyone without the passphrase. Everyone in the conversation needs this mod and the same phrase; to everyone else the line is a run of Base64. That cost is why this is off by default.
chatutils.option.encryption_passphrase.d: The shared secret. Anyone who has it can read every message sent with it, so it is worth as much as the conversation is — and it sits in chatutils.json in plain text. This is a curtain, not a vault.
chatutils.encrypt.too_long: Too long to encrypt — keep it under %s characters. Sending it anyway would arrive as noise.
chatutils.encrypt.failed: Could not encrypt (%s), so nothing was sent.
chatutils.option.auto_reply.desc: Someone says a phrase, you say your answer. Off by default and worth leaving that way unless you want it: a server cannot tell an eager player from a bot, and people are banned for this. Four brakes guard against loops, one of which is a ceiling of four replies a minute that no setting can raise.
chatutils.option.auto_reply_cooldown.des: How long before the same phrase may be answered again.
chatutils.option.auto_reply_rules.desc: One per line as phrase | response, e.g. "gg | ggwp". Whole words only, so "gg" does not fire on "logging". Your own messages are never answered, and neither is your own reply coming back at you.
chatutils.command.help_toggles: /chatutils hidechat · bubbles · heads · filter · mentions · autoreply · encrypt · streams — turn a feature on or off
chatutils.command.help_screens: /chatutils settings · history · clear — open the settings, open the log, empty the log
